name: How long does a typical kitchen flooring installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen flooring installation varies based on the material, kitchen size, and subfloor preparation required. For a standard-sized kitchen, a simple LVP installation might take 1-2 days. Tile or complex pattern installations, which involve more cutting, grouting, and drying time, typically range from 3-5 days. Extensive subfloor repairs or leveling can add significantly to this timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after assessing your specific kitchen.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical kitchen flooring installation can take anywhere from 1-5 days, depending on the material, kitchen size, and subfloor preparation needs.
